AIR PERMIT APPLICATIONS RECIEVED

The table below lists applications for air pollution control permit actions currently under review by DNR’s Air Management Program. The applications will remain on this list up to 180 days or until DNR posts a public notice that the review of the application is available for public comment. Once the application becomes available for public comment, the draft permit will move to the public comment table. When a final permit decision is made, the item will move to the Air permit final decisions table.

The application is viewable by clicking on the permit number.
